blogs.title: Hello everyone. Welcome to CodersHub.
blogs.body:
This is the first note in CodersHub, a growing corner of the web for builders, learners, and curious minds.

I created this space to collect the things that help me move forward: experiments that teach me something new, websites worth returning to, videos that explain difficult ideas clearly, and small lessons from the projects I am working on.

There is no pressure to have everything figured out here. Good engineering is built one question, one useful tool, and one thoughtful improvement at a time. Some notes will be practical. Some will be personal. Some may simply be a reminder that progress is still progress, even when the code does not work on the first try.

I hope CodersHub becomes a useful place to return to, contribute to, and build from. Welcome in. Let us keep learning, making, and sharing what we find.
